health.title: Site health
health.sub: Is the shop up, fast and error-free? Green means nothing to do.
health.needs: Something needs a look: {n} of the lights below is not green.

up.none: The server has not reported its own check yet.
up.ok: The server's own check found nothing wrong.
up.problems: The server's own check found {n} problem(s). See below.
up.stale: The server's own check last ran {hours} hours ago.

nightly.none: No page check has been reported yet.
nightly.stale: The page check last ran {hours} hours ago.

backup.none: No server backup has been reported yet.
backup.ok: The last server backup went through.
backup.stale: The last server backup was {hours} hours ago.

drill.none: No restore test has run yet.
drill.ok: The last restore test brought a backup back successfully.

ssl.none: No certificate check has been reported yet.
ssl.days: The lock renews by itself; {n} days left on this one.

found.none: Nothing. The server's own check reports no problems.

alerts.d: Alerts for a shop that is down, a failed backup or a lost ERP link go to Telegram. The page check runs after every update and every night.

updates.title: Updates & versions
updates.sub: Which version runs now, what changed in plain words, and a safe way back.
updates.notInstalled: No install time has been reported yet.

how.d: An update is installed only after every check passes. Before it goes live the server tests the new version on the staging shop; if the page check fails afterwards, the shop goes back to the last good version by itself.
how.back: Going back to an earlier version is done through a new update from the build list, so orders and data stay as they are.

last.none: The server has not reported a deploy yet.

build.d: From the build register: finished work over all planned work.
